title: PanoUAV-Track: Full-Spherical UAV Visual Tracking in the Wild
abstract: arXiv:2611.27383v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Existing UAV tracking benchmarks predominantly rely on perspective cameras with limited fields of view. Omnidirectional cameras enable full-spherical observation, yet tracking from moving UAV platforms remains largely unexplored. Unlike ground-level panoramic tracking, UAV-mounted omnidirectional cameras observe targets across both azimuth and elevation, introducing geometric challenges under equirectangular projection (ERP). To investigate this setting, we capture approximately \textbf{40 hours of real-world 8K panoramic UAV video} and construct \textbf{PanoUAV-Track} through temporal clip extraction, target annotation, and the integration of simulated sequences. The resulting benchmark comprises 1,895 sequences, 507,961 frames, and 2,872 annotated objects, covering real-world daytime and nighttime scenes alongside simulation, and supporting both visual and language-based target specification. translated_title: PanoUAV-Track：野外环境下的全球形无人机视觉跟踪
translated_abstract: 现有的无人机（UAV）跟踪基准主要依赖视场受限的透视相机。全向相机能够实现全球面观测，但从移动的无人机平台上进行跟踪在很大程度上仍未被探索。与地面全景跟踪不同，安装在无人机上的全向相机需要在方位角和仰角两个维度上观测目标，这在等距圆柱投影（ERP）下引入了几何上的挑战。为了研究这一场景，我们采集了约40小时的真实世界8K全景无人机视频，并通过时间片段提取、目标标注以及模拟序列的集成构建了PanoUAV-Track基准。该基准包含1,895个序列、507,961帧图像和2,872个标注目标，涵盖真实世界的日间与夜间场景以及仿真场景，同时支持基于视觉和基于语言的目标指定方式。通过大量评估实验，我们揭示了……
tldr: 该论文构建了首个面向移动无人机平台的全球形视觉跟踪基准PanoUAV-Track，基于40小时真实8K全景视频，包含1,895个序列、507,961帧和2,872个标注目标，填补了无人机全向跟踪（含ERP投影几何挑战及日夜场景）的研究空白。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces PanoUAV-Track, the first full-spherical visual tracking benchmark for moving UAV platforms, built from 40 hours of real-world 8K panoramic video with 1,895 sequences, 507,961 frames, and 2,872 annotated objects, addressing geometric challenges of ERP projection and filling the gap in omnidirectional UAV tracking.
